name: Spook
summary: The youngest member of Kelsier's crew, a Tineye with the ability to flare his senses physically. Quiet, overlooked, and desperately seeking validation, Spook's journey from a shy teenager to a hardened leader is one of the most dramatic transformations in the series. He is burned by a mysterious fire that leaves him scarred but grants him a unique allomantic ability, and later leads the underground resistance in Luthadel after Vin and Elend leave. He marries Beldre and becomes a revered figure known as the Lord Mistborn, but his later life is complicated by the discovery of his true heritage and his role in Scadrial's history.
